the diatom diversity in the Finnish Lake District is highest in the middle of the Holocene.
the species diversity of the diatom lake communities in Finland increased from a few species immediately after deglaciation to a large number of species at the present time.

the development of the postglacial diatoms in Finnish lakes.
the development of the species diversity in diatom lake communities in Finland during the postglacial period.
the pattern of development of the species diversity of diatom communities in Finnish lakes.

the diatom communities of these Finnish lakes have developed from simple to complex communities in the same manner as the terrestrial plant communities.

the diatom species diversity is a useful tool for the analysis of the development of aquatic ecosystems.
